(i) seminal plasma of infertile men contains lower levels of anandamide and 2-aracidonoyl glycerol, the main endocannabinoids (ECs) in the endocannabinoid (EC) system, and (ii) infertile sperm show an increased degradation of these ECs.
we identified unprecedented alterations of endocannabinoid levels and their related enzymes in sperm from infertoile men.

the endocannabinoid (EC) system (ECS) is altered in infertile men, with a clear reduction in EC content, and a marked increase in the activity of the enzymes involved in the degradation of the main ECs.

the role of the endocannabinoid (eCB) system in the male reproductive system.

the endocannabinoid (EC) system is involved in the pathogenesis of male infertility, and that its dysregulation may be used as a marker of male fertility status.
